ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — Added Mod (P2)
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: The mod that is ADDED to the active list between run A and run B, exercising the added-defs channel (P2). It contributes brand-new concrete ThingDefs that do NOT exist in run A's baseline DependencyGraph.json, plus a patch that modifies one of them so the recompute is non-trivial. The runner (TestMods/run_test.sh --expect-added) symlinks it always but only inserts its packageId into ModsConfig.xml before run B, so run B is a genuine mod-list change and its defs appear as added (absent from the baseline graph). No game content — dev/QA use only.
